text: ↩️ Reply to OSINT Visioner BIG | 🇮🇷 🇺🇸 🇮🇱 ‼️ ‼️ Iran is openly signaling that future U.S. and Israeli actions could push Tehran toward withdrawing from the Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty, although Iranian officials insist that no such decision has been made. Speaking to Al Jazeera, Supreme National Security Council Secretary Mohsen Rezaei said any potential withdrawal from the NPT would depend on Washington’s next moves. He maintained that Iran remains committed to Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei’s religious decree prohibiting the development of nuclear weapons and said Tehran’s nuclear doctrine has not changed, while adding, “We do not know what will happen in the future.” An Iranian withdrawal from the NPT would represent a major escalation in the nuclear confrontation, weakening the international framework governing Tehran’s nuclear activities and adding another layer of uncertainty to an already volatile conflict. For now, Rezaei’s remarks amount to a warning rather than a declared policy change, with Tehran explicitly tying its future position to what the United States and Israel do next. See the latest updates with us: @visionergeo tweet

text: ↩️ Reply to OSINT Visioner BIG | 🇱🇻 🇺🇦 🇪🇺 ‼️ ‼️ Europe is struggling to keep pace with the extraordinary speed at which drone and air warfare is evolving in Ukraine, Latvian President Edgars Rinkēvičs has warned, arguing that capabilities European militaries are preparing today could already be outdated by next year. Speaking to The Guardian, Rinkēvičs said European countries still lack sufficient air-defense, counter-drone and ballistic-missile defense capabilities to deal with a potential Russian attack, while expanding systems such as Patriot remains painfully slow. He contrasted that pace with Ukraine, where battlefield technology and tactics are evolving at “lightning speed” and drone production has reached roughly 200,000 units per month. The warning highlights one of Europe’s biggest defense challenges. Ukraine is adapting weapons and battlefield technology on timescales measured in months, while European procurement and industrial expansion can take years. Kyiv’s experience is increasingly becoming a real-world benchmark for how European militaries may need to reorganize procurement, production and air defense for a battlefield that is changing faster than traditional defense systems can adapt. See the latest updates with us: @visionergeo tweet

France is not only strengthening defenses against sabotage, cyberattacks and other hybrid threats, but is also prepared to respond through measures that remain outside public view. text: Zelensky: People of different generations left. Many people took their children — small children. Elderly people of different ages left. Many people did not leave and went to the front. text_zh: 泽连斯基：不同世代的人都离开了。许多人带走了他们的孩子——年幼的孩子。不同年龄的老年人都离开了。许多人没有离开，而是去了前线。嗯，战争就是战争。每个人都做出了自己的选择。同样，每个人在战争结束后的最初几天里也会做出自己的选择。

text: Zelensky: The war will end, I am sure people will return. I do not know what percentage will return. It will depend on what I said: education, on parents who did not allow their children to forget Ukraine — in their hearts, in their minds, in everything. And it will certainly depend on the rebuilding of the state, the conditions for doing business, and jobs.
text_zh: 泽连斯基：战争会结束，我相信人们会回来。我不知道会有百分之多少的人回来。这将取决于我所说的：教育，取决于那些没有让孩子忘记乌克兰的父母——在他们的心中，在他们的思想中，在一切事物中。这当然也取决于国家的重建、营商环境以及就业机会。

text: Zelensky: Our enemy is Russia — for Ukraine, for independence, for democracy. And if this is about democracy, about Europe, then it is a common enemy for Poland as well. In such cases, we need unity not only with Poland, but with all of Europe. First of all with Poland, because we are big neighbors and we must be friends.
text_zh: 泽连斯基：我们的敌人是俄罗斯——为了乌克兰，为了独立，为了民主。如果这关乎民主，关乎欧洲，那么它对波兰来说也是共同的敌人。在这种情况下，我们不仅需要与波兰团结一致，还需要与整个欧洲团结一致。首先是与波兰，因为我们是伟大的邻居，我们必须成为朋友。

text: France’s far-right National Rally (RN) leaders Marine Le Pen and Jordan Bardella issued a rare condemnation of Russia, warning against Moscow using intimidation, threats and destabilization to influence France. “We will never tolerate a foreign power, in this case, Russia, seeking to dictate, directly or indirectly, the policy of our country through intimidation, threats, destabilization or psychological pressure.” The statement condemned Russia’s seizure of assets belonging to French retailer Auchan and Swiss company Nestlé, calling it: “A hostile act against the interests of France and the nations of Europe.” Le Pen and Bardella also referenced Russia-linked hybrid threats, including the August drone attack at Leipzig airport, and said: “No provocation, clandestine operation, or destabilization effort could lead France to facilitate Russia’s achievement of its war aims in Ukraine.” Source: POLITICO
text_zh: 法国极右翼政党“国民联盟”（RN）领导人玛丽娜·勒庞和乔丹·巴尔德拉罕见地谴责了俄罗斯，警告莫斯科不要利用恐吓、威胁和破坏稳定来影响法国。“我们绝不容忍任何外国势力，在这种情况下是俄罗斯，试图通过恐吓、威胁、破坏稳定或心理压力，直接或间接地左右我国的政策。”该声明谴责了俄罗斯扣押法国零售商欧尚和瑞士公司雀巢资产的行为，称其为：“针对法国和欧洲各国利益的敌对行为。”勒庞和巴尔德拉还提到了与俄罗斯有关的混合威胁，包括8月份莱比锡机场的无人机袭击事件，并表示：“任何挑衅、秘密行动或破坏稳定的努力，都无法促使法国协助俄罗斯实现其在乌克兰的战争目标。” 来源：POLITICO
